purpose: Gives the Code lane (D36's zero-supply admission) its first real, measured data point: a single-shard spot-sample of codeparrot/github-code-clean, restricted to permissively licensed files, with the shard's overall permissive-license fraction reported for extrapolation.
upstream_source: codeparrot/github-code (BigQuery GitHub public dataset export, query executed 2022-03-16), quality-filtered by CodeParrot
license_note: Each row carries the license of its origin GitHub repository (dataset's own 'license' column). This audit reports figures for the permissive allowlist only (['apache-2.0', 'bsd-2-clause', 'bsd-3-clause', 'cc0-1.0', 'isc', 'mit', 'unlicense']); copyleft licenses (gpl-2.0/3.0, agpl-3.0, lgpl-2.1/3.0) and ambiguous ones (mpl-2.0, epl-1.0, artistic-2.0) are measured but excluded from the sampled/selected figures below.
scope: Single shard (train-00000-of-00880.parquet) out of 883 -- NOT the full corpus. This shard's license mix is reported as the basis for any full-corpus extrapolation; do not assume it is representative without a wider multi-shard sample.

full_corpus_extrapolation.method: shard_stats value x 883 (total shards in codeparrot/github-code-clean's data/ directory), assuming roughly uniform rows-per-shard -- a single-shard order-of-magnitude estimate, not a measurement.
full_corpus_extrapolation.consistency_check: Estimated total rows can be cross-checked against the dataset card's own arithmetic: codeparrot/github-code cites 115M files, github-code-clean's README states 3.39M files (2.94%) were removed by quality filtering, i.e. ~111.6M files expected -- compare against estimated_total_rows above.

caveats: This is a single-shard spot-sample, not a full-corpus audit -- do not extrapolate this shard's 52.8% permissive-token fraction to the full ~847GB corpus without a wider sample across languages and shard-export dates.
License is inherited from the origin repository at BigQuery export time (2022); it is not re-verified per-file and may be stale relative to the repository's current license.
Secret/PII scrubbing here is a coarse regex heuristic, not a production-grade secret scanner -- flagged as 'audit' status, same as every other S5 lane's pii stage.
Tokenized with cl100k_base for cross-lane audit comparability; a real Code-lane pretraining run would use a code-aware tokenizer (e.g. StarCoder's BPE), not this one.
